parsed.reason: Description A concerns port/userinfo being dropped by parts.hostname so origins with ports are treated as partner hosts and the non-normalised origin is echoed. Description B concerns the suffix check host.endswith(domain) matching unrelated domains like bluekettle.example for partner kettle.example. These are different root causes (userinfo/port handling versus missing dot-boundary in suffix matching).
